#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Send an email with a PDF attachment via SMTP."""

import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

# ── Configuration (update these) ─────────────────────────────────
SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.example.com"   # e.g. smtp.gmail.com
SMTP_PORT = 587
SMTP_USER = "you@example.com"
SMTP_PASS = "your-app-password"    # use an app password, not your real password

FROM_ADDR = "you@example.com"
TO_ADDR = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT = "Customer Report"
BODY = "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"
ATTACHMENT = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = FROM_ADDR
msg["To"] = TO_ADDR
msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
msg.attach(MIMEText(BODY, "plain"))

with open(ATTACHMENT, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f'attachment; filename="customer_report.pdf"')
    msg.attach(part)

with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT) as server:
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
    server.sendmail(FROM_ADDR, TO_ADDR, msg.as_string())

print(f"Email sent to {TO_ADDR} with attachment: {ATTACHMENT}")
